cards.label: Life Support
cards.scene: Inside a quiet Mars habitat, an empty water tank beside an inactive oxygen machine, both with empty gauge indicators. A broad window shows the geometric Mars hills. A large outlined health cross with a broken pulse line represents combined life support. Keep both machines visually simple and distinctly separate.
cards.copy: Your crew needs oxygen to breathe and water to drink. Life Support ran out.
cards.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished portrait 3:4 ending card concept for the children's Mars resource-management game Next Frontier. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its extremely simple flat geometric vector-like illustration, layered angular Martian mountains, smooth restrained sky gradient, solid polygon surfaces, muted dusk purple #211f38, dusty terracotta #945f50 and warm sand #e9bc91. Do not recreate the exact landscape. No photorealism, no 3D render, no painterly brushwork, no texture, no visual noise. All six cards form a coherent matching deck. Full-bleed single card, modest rounded corners, thin muted violet frame and deep purple lower text panel, no tabletop or surrounding mockup. Top 60% is a clear story illustration with large simple shapes and sparse detail. Bottom 40% is clean readable typography, warm off-white, large friendly sans-serif, centered. Include one large simple outlined cause-of-failure symbol within the scene. Child-appropriate, quiet disappointment, no dead or injured people, no catastrophe spectacle, no NASA logo or endorsement. No button or game HUD. Text must be exactly the resource name, then the dominant heading "Mission Failed", then the specified short sentence. Scientific depiction: no water magically becoming oxygen; radiation never consumes shielding; no instant human death.
Resource label (verbatim): "Life Support". Scene: Inside a quiet Mars habitat, an empty water tank beside an inactive oxygen machine, both with empty gauge indicators. A broad window shows the geometric Mars hills. A large outlined health cross with a broken pulse line represents combined life support. Keep both machines visually simple and distinctly separate.

cards.label: Oxygen

Large outlined lungs with a diagonal slash as the failure symbol. No water tank, no gas leaking into open space, no people.
cards.copy: The oxygen supply ran out. Your crew needs air to breathe.

cards.label: Water

cards.copy: The water supply ran out. Your crew needs water to drink and run the base.

cards.label: Radiation Shield
cards.scene: Exterior of a small Mars shelter at dusk with its protective outer water-tank barrier visibly missing or empty around the habitat. The intact habitat remains unbroken. Subtle thin solar particle lines in sky and a large outlined cracked shield symbol express insufficient protection. Radiation is NOT eating or burning the shield. No explosions, no glowing radioactive waste, no destruction.
cards.copy: The shelter has no shielding left. The crew must stop the mission.

cards.label: Energy

Dominant unmistakable lightning-bolt failure symbol split into TWO separated jagged halves with a clear empty gap, a couple small break marks; no lightning storm or explosion.
cards.copy: The energy supply ran out. The base cannot keep its machines running.

Large outlined empty food-box symbol with a small cross over it. No fresh lettuce claiming to replace dry food, no distressed people.
